name: NASA PCoE Li-ion Battery Aging Data Set
source: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence (PCoE) Data Repository; retrieved via GitHub LFS mirror bluemind1285-ux/DSP because phm-datasets.s3.amazonaws.com was unreachable from the build sandbox
licence: U.S. Government public data (citation requested: Saha & Goebel 2007)
variables: Voltage_measured, Current_measured, Temperature_measured, Current_load/charge, Voltage_load/charge, Time, Capacity, EIS (Battery_impedance, Re, Rct), ambient_temperature, cycle start time
known_limitations: 4 C cells have unexplained low-capacity runs (NASA README); B0049-52 ended by software crash; B0025-28 duplicated in archives 2 and 3 (byte-identical, deduplicated); chemistry reported as LiCoO2 or NCA in literature (unconfirmed)
processing: All 6 inner zips extracted; 34 unique cells parsed (scipy.io.loadmat); current sign flipped to +discharge; cycle-level health indicators; preceding-charge and last-EIS context attached with as-of joins; flags (capacity<0.5 Ah; NASA capacity vs Ah-integration mismatch>0.15 Ah) kept, not deleted; incremental-capacity (dQ/dV) indicators computed on every CC charge

name: KU Leuven BEV energy dynamics dataset V2
source: KU Leuven Research Data Repository (RDR); downloaded from https://rdr.kuleuven.be/api/access/datafile/272593
variables: Timestamp, SOCave292 (BMS SOC), BattVoltage132, RawBattCurrent132, BMS min/max pack temperature, VCFRONT_tempAmbient, DI_uiSpeed, ChargeLinePower264, FC_dcCurrent/Voltage, BMSdissipation312, BMS max discharge/regen power, UI_Range
known_limitations: SOC is BMS-reported; vehicles not labelled LFP/NCA in files; slow-charge sessions have logging gaps (median 62% of time logged); parking sessions (781 files, 655 MB) not processed
processing: fast (25), slow (109) and driving (1,392 of 1,396 non-trivial) session CSVs read; 15 signals kept and renamed; GPS dropped; forward/back-fill of CAN signals within a session; session summaries (energy, distance, logged-time fraction, implied capacity only on >90%-logged sessions)
